Disturbance Explorer Report

Date: 2026-06-02

This report summaries disturbance metrics for the chosen study area. The range spans 13200 km², of which 94.6% is classified as undisturbed and 5.4% as disturbed. In this analysis, disturbed areas include only features selected for this assessment: buffered anthropogenic disturbances only. Undisturbed areas are defined as all remaining portions of the study area not intersected by these selected disturbances, regardless of the presence of other disturbance types that may exist within the study area but were not included in the analysis.

Anthropogenic disturbances include 1032.7 km of linear features and 9.0 km² of areal disturbances.

To generate the disturbed areas layer, a generic buffer of 500 m for linear features and 500 m for areal disturbances were used.

The following disturbance types were present within the study area but excluded from the disturbed areas: mining claims and fires.

No protected areas intersect the study area.
